title: DNA extraction from feathers
author: George Olah
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzu2p6ye
materials: Unpack appropriate number of spin column + collection tubes (according to the number of samples you are extracting) from QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504 and label them with the sample IDs accordingly.
Preheat appropriate volume of Buffer AE Qiagen Catalog #19077 ( 100 µL x number of samples + a little extra) to 70 °C .

steps.title: Collect and store feather samples
steps.instruction: Avoid touching feather tips; if wet, dry on paper towel. Place each feather in a separate paper envelope labeled with sample ID, collection date, location, species, and collector name. Store envelopes in an airtight dry box with silica gel at room temperature.

steps.title: Label extraction tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label a 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock tube (PCR clean, colorless, catalog #022363212) for each feather with its unique sample ID.

steps.title: Gather required consumables
steps.instruction: Obtain a clean A4 paper sheet, a pair of gloves, and sterile scalpel blades.

steps.title: Wear gloves and position feather
steps.instruction: Put on gloves, remove the feather from its envelope, and place it on the clean A4 paper sheet.

steps.title: Isolate blood clot from feather
steps.instruction: Using sterile scalpel blades, isolate the blood clot from the feather:

substeps.instruction: Large feathers: cut a window around the blood clot at the superior umbilicus (just below the vane).
Small feathers (<20 mm): chop the entire shaft.

steps.title: Transfer clot to labeled tube
steps.instruction: Place the isolated clot into the corresponding labeled Eppendorf tube. Dispose of the used scalpel blade in a yellow sharps container.

steps.title: Return feather and dispose waste
steps.instruction: Put the remaining part of the feather back into its envelope. Dispose of the A4 paper and gloves.

steps.title: Surface sterilization with ethanol
steps.instruction: Clean the surface of the feather with 70 % ethanol using a paper towel.

steps.title: Add Buffer ATL lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL of Buffer ATL (Qiagen catalog #19076) to each tube.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Proteinase K (Qiagen catalog #19131, 20 mg/mL) to each tube.

steps.title: Vortex tube 20 seconds
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate 1 hour at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes for 1 hour at 56 °C on a block heater.

steps.title: Overnight incubation at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes overnight at 56 °C on a block heater.

steps.title: Vortex tube 20 seconds again
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube for another 20 seconds.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Buffer AL (Qiagen catalog #19076) to each tube.

steps.title: Vortex 15 seconds and spin down
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube for 15 seconds, then spin down briefly.

steps.title: Incubate 45 minutes at 70 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes for 45 minutes at 70 °C on a block heater.

steps.title: Add DTT solution
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 1 M DTT (Merck MilliporeSigma catalog #10708984001) to each tube to dissolve creatine.

steps.title: Add ethanol and spin down
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly, then add 210 µL of 100 % ethanol to each tube and spin down briefly again.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate 5 min at RT
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to spin column
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly, then pipette the lysate from each tube into the correspondingly labeled spin column using 1 mL pipette tips.

steps.title: Centrifuge 10,000 rpm 1 min
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 1 minute (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Discard flow‑through, relocate column
steps.instruction: Discard the collection tube with filtrate and place the spin column into a clean collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Buffer AW1 (Qiagen catalog #19081) to the column and centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Discard flow‑through, relocate column
steps.instruction: Discard the collection tube with filtrate and place the spin column into a new clean collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Buffer AW2 (Qiagen catalog #19072) and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Place column in clean tube (lid cut)
steps.instruction: Discard the collection tube with filtrate and place the spin column into a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube whose lid has been cut off.

steps.title: Prepare elution tubes (cut lids)
steps.instruction: Prepare as many 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes as samples in the batch and cut off their lids.

steps.title: Add pre‑heated Buffer AE and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of pre‑heated Buffer AE (Qiagen catalog #19077) to each column and incubate at 70 °C for 5 minutes on a block heater.

steps.title: Centrifuge elution 10,000 rpm 1 min
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the elution for 1 minute at 10,000 rpm.

steps.title: Re‑elute to concentrate DNA
steps.instruction: Lift the spin column, pipette the ~100 µL eluate back onto the column, then centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Incubate eluate 70 °C 1 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate at 70 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to labeled microtubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to labeled 1.5 mL screw‑cap microtubes.

steps.title: Store DNA at 4 °C or –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the screw‑cap tubes at 4 °C for short‑term or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Create negative control tube
steps.instruction: Label an empty tube as a negative control for the subsequent steps.

steps.title: Label final storage tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 mL screw‑cap microtubes and label them with species, sample ID, extraction date, and DNA amount (µL) for final storage.
